topic: ICSE 10th Board Section A - General Pattern & MCQs (20 Marks)

questions.question: What type of data structures are Arrays and Classes considered?
questions.explanation: A data type that represents a number of similar or different data under a single declaration is called a composite data type (or non-primitive type)[cite: 1].

questions.question: Which Wrapper Class corresponds to the primitive type 'char'?
questions.explanation: The Java wrapper class explicitly designated for the primitive data type 'char' is 'Character'[cite: 1].

questions.question: Which math function is utilized to compute exponents (base raised to a power)?
questions.explanation: The Math.pow() function handles exponentiation, accurately taking two parameters: base and power[cite: 1].

questions.question: What is the technical description of 'Unboxing' in Java?
options: Converting an object to an array
Converting wrapper class objects into primitive data types
Typecasting a double to an int
questions.answer: Converting wrapper class objects into primitive data types
questions.explanation: Unboxing is the system of converting an object of a wrapper class completely into primitive data type[cite: 1].

questions.question: What is an absolute necessity before utilizing Binary Search on an array?
options: Array must be sorted in an order
questions.answer: Array must be sorted in an order
questions.explanation: Binary search technique can be used exclusively when the array elements are completely sorted in an order[cite: 1].

questions.question: What happens if a method is strictly defined with a return type of 'void'?
options: It performs actions but does not return any output value
questions.answer: It performs actions but does not return any output value
questions.explanation: A procedural function defined with the return type void fundamentally performs some actions but definitively does not return any output value[cite: 1].

questions.question: What precisely does the compareTo() string method calculate to determine output?
questions.explanation: The compareTo() method calculates and returns an integer representing the exact ASCII difference between the two strings[cite: 1].

questions.question: Which of the following method signatures successfully overloads 'void obj(int a, double b)'?
questions.explanation: Function overloading can be effortlessly implemented by rearranging or altering the strict order of parameters within two identically named methods[cite: 1].

questions.question: Which String method deletes whitespace from both endpoints of the text?
questions.explanation: The trim() function aggressively removes all white/blank spaces situated at the beginning as well as the end of a string[cite: 2].
